name: Locked list reveal
oneLiner: a numbered glass list builds row by row and the open rows write themselves in behind a glowing caret, while one row stays hatched and blurred under a padlock; at the end the lock shakes and springs open, the row floods with the accent and its label is revealed (or it clamps shut and glows as a tease)
say: when the speaker lists the steps and holds one back ("there are five steps, and step four is the one nobody talks about"): cut in on the count; the lock opens on the word that names it. unlock false when the step is held for later in the video or behind a lead magnet
